''[…]'' First of all, your head tendrils droop when you're sad, but they go straight back when you're afraid.|[[Human]] [[Padawan]] [[Lula Mrala-Talisola|Lula Talisola]] speaks with the Mikkian Zeen Mrala|[[The High Republic Adventures (2021) 4|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2021) 4]]}} '''Mikkians''' were a [[humanoid]] [[species]] that were [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Mikkia]], identifiable by their manes of head-tendrils and their bright skin [[Color|pigmentation]]. The [[twin]] sisters [[Tiplar]] and [[Tiplee]], who fought and [[Death|died]] in the [[Clone Wars]] as [[Jedi Master]]s, were Mikkians. Another member of the species, a [[Gender|female]] named [[Sakas]], fought with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. ==Biology and appearance== {{Quote|Those tendrils are really uncomfortable. Beautiful! So attractive! Love to look at them. Hate to have to copy them.|The [[Changeling|shape-shifting]] individual [[Zae-Brii]] to their Mikkian girlfriend Audj Seedol|}} [[File:Tiplee-TCWForceWarriors.png|thumb|left|250px|Tiplee, a red-skinned Mikkian with head-tendrils coming from the sides of her head.]] The Mikkians were a [[species]] of brightly [[color]]ed [[humanoid]]s. Members had four [[limb]]s: two legs, and two arms with five-fingered hands, including an opposable thumb. Their heads had two forward-facing [[eye]]s, whose irises could be blue or black. However, the Mikkians' most distinctive feature were their motile head-tendrils, the number, form, and pattern varying between individuals. These head-tendrils primarily served as sensory organs, particularly detecting sound as a replacement for an [[ear]] common in other species. However, some Mikkians, such as [[Zeen Mrala-Talisola|Zeen Mrala]], possessed ears in addition to head-tendrils. Mikkian head-tendrils also could detect other information, such as humidity, [[temperature]], [[magnet]]ic direction, and [[radiation]]. This radiation detection was sensitive enough that Mikkians could "see" light and dark, although their eyes were still their primary visual organs. Mikkians' skin and tendrils ranged in pigmentation from bright yellows and greens to reds and pinks and blues. Many Mikkians also had specks and shadows of other colors at parts of their body. Coloration varied greatly even among closely related individuals. For example, even [[twin]]s, such as [[Tiplee]] and [[Tiplar]], or [[parent]]s and children could have vastly different skin pigmentations. Some members of the species were [[Force-sensitive|sensitive]] to [[the Force]]. ==Society and culture== Mikkians placed kinship and integrity above all. In fact, their honesty could come across as blunt or even rude to other sentients. Conversely, Mikkians often had trouble adjusting to the more flexible views of other races. Their complex code of honor encompassed all things in life, with a particular insistance on matters of warfare. Although they respected warrior traditions, the Mikkians nevertheless valued discipline and honor over victory or physical might. Their [[Mikkian (language)|native]] [[language]] was a melodic, flowing tongue made up of several ancient dialects. Although most Mikkians were proud of their language, they had no qualms about learning [[Galactic Basic Standard]]. Different religious traditions existed among the Mikkians, but belief in [[the Force]] played a central role in all of them. As such, when the [[Jedi Order]] were branded as traitors by the [[Galactic Empire]], Mikkians were quick to question the Empire's reasoning. In Mikkian society, their head-tendrils had important cultural significance, and as such [[tendril-reading]] was used by Mikkian mystics to predict their future. Every facet of the head-tendril contributed to that meaning. ==History== [[File:Force_Speed_2018_SWD_Store_Championship_alt_card.png|thumb|right|250px|Mikkian twins, Tiplee and Tiplar during the Battle of Ringo Vinda.]] The Mikkians [[Homeworld|hailed]] from the [[Expansion Region]] [[planet]] [[Mikkia]]. A secretive species, much about them remained a mystery to the larger [[The galaxy|galactic]] community,''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' however, Mikkia itself had been part of the [[Galactic Republic]] for [[Millennium|millennia]], and still held a seat at its [[Proclamation of the New Order|dissolution]]. ==Mikkians in the galaxy== Millennia before the [[Galactic Civil War]], the Mikkians joined the Galactic Republic. During the [[High Republic Era]], the Mikkian [[Zeen Mrala-Talisola|Zeen Mrala]] and her [[parent]]s were members of the [[Elders of the Path]], a wandering religious group that disdained the use of the Force. Mrala's Force-sensitivity, which she had spent her entire life attempting to conceal, eventually revealed itself during an [[Trymant IV disaster|Emergence]] of the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster]] at [[Trymant IV]], leading to a rift with her best friend [[Krix Kamerat]].[[The High Republic Adventures (2021) 2|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2021) 2]] [[Standard decade|Decades]] to [[Standard century|centuries]] later a [[colony ship]] containing members of various species, including Mikkians, stranded on the remote planet [[Lenahra]]. Four generations later only twelve [[Lenahran]]s remained, including the Mikkian siblings [[Audj Seedol|Audj]] and [[Casul Seedol]]. In the waning [[Standard year|years]] of the Galactic Republic, the Mikkian [[twin]] sisters [[Tiplee]] and [[Tiplar]] were both part of the Force-wielding [[Jedi Order]]. By the [[time]] of the [[Clone Wars]], they had attained the rank of [[Jedi Master]] and served as [[Jedi General]]s in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. In that capacity, they led [[clone trooper]]s in battle against the [[Confederacy military|forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. One [[Unidentified Mikkian Jedi|red-skinned Mikkian]] was a Jedi during the war and the master to a [[Unidentified Jedi Padawan (Grievous)|Padawan]]. However, both were killed by [[General]] [[Grievous]] near the [[Ledeve]] [[Jedi Temple (Ledeve)|Jedi Temple]].[[Age of Republic - General Grievous 1|''Age of Republic - General Grievous'' 1]] [[File:TipleeMournsTiplar-TU.png|thumb|left|250px|Tiplee cradles her sister's body.]] During the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda]], Tiplar was [[Death|killed]] by one of her [[soldier]]s, the [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]] [[Tup]], whose [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chip]] had malfunctioned, forcing him to execute [[Order 66]] prematurely. Later in the war, her sister led an [[Assault on Vizsla Keep 09|assault]] on [[Vizsla Keep 09]], where the [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]] was hiding. Tiplee was stabbed through the chest during a [[lightsaber duel]] with [[Count]] [[Dooku]], leader of the Confederacy, who had formed an alliance with Maul.[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]] A red-skinned male Mikkian was present during the [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral of Maarva Kerasi Andor]] on [[Ferrix]]. When the citizens of Ferrix began [[Ferrix Riot|rioting]] against the Imperial forces, this Mikkian joined the uprising, fighting a [[Stormtrooper]] with his bare hands. {{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} During the [[Galactic Civil War]], a female Mikkian named [[Sakas]] served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], a resistance movement that fought the autocratic [[Galactic Empire]]. As a member of the [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces]], she participated in a [[Raid at the Wretch of Tayron|raid]] against an Imperial black site at the [[Wretch of Tayron]]. ==Behind the scenes== was based on unused pieces of concept art for a female [[Sith]] that [[Iain McCaig]] created for the film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-unknown-trivia-gallery|text="The Unknown" Trivia Gallery}} Caig had been determined to design the new Sith as a woman, after having already played with the idea when designing [[Maul|Darth Maul]], to give female ''[[Star Wars]]'' fans an icon that could be compared to Maul or [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. For this, Caig designed multiple images of "[[Wikipedia:Medusa|Medusa]]-like" figures''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]'' that would later evolve into the Mikkians; one with grey skin dated to "6/4/[[1999]]" and one with yellow skin close to Tiplar. However, the species' name was only revealed in [[June]] [[2015]], on the official website for [[Kabam]]'s then-upcoming [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Uprising]]''. At the time, future players were given the opportunity to vote for either [[Mirialan]]s or Mikkians to become the game's fourth playable species. The Mikkian icon depicted a female whose mane of tendrils resembled those of Tiplar and Tiplee.{{WebCite|url=https://playstarwarsuprising.com|text=Star Wars: Uprising—Shape the Future of the Game|date=2015-06-04|work=[https://web.archive.org/web/20150606014337/https://playstarwarsuprising.com Star Wars: Uprising]|archivedate=20150606014337}} After [[Amy Ratcliffe]] pointed out the resemblance on Twitter, the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' account confirmed that the Jedi twins were indeed Mikkians, and that [http://www.starwars.com/databank/mikkian a new entry] reflecting that fact would soon be added in the official [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/606573815561355265|[[Star Wars]]|quote=@amy_geek @JoaquinSlowly @BlueJaigEyes Correct. We'll be adding to the databank soon.|archivefile=File:Mikkian_twitter_conversation.png}} Once the vote ended on [[June 30]],{{Twitter|KabamRPG|status/615986172901265408|[[Kabam]]|quote=Today is your last chance to vote on the fourth playable race! Mikkian or Mirialan?|archivefile=File:Mikkian_end_vote__tweet.png}} the Mirialan species won and was added to the game.
